headline: UBS-BB upgrades Cosan to buy, citing 45% valuation discount
summary: UBS-BB upgraded Cosan (CSAN3) to buy, noting the stock trades at a 35% to 45% discount to its intrinsic value following a recent 40% decline.
why: Cosan is a major Brazilian conglomerate with interests in energy, logistics, and agriculture; analyst upgrades can drive short-term price recovery.

impacts.name: Cosan
impacts.why: Analyst upgrades often lead to increased buying interest.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The upgrade highlights a perceived valuation gap, prompting investors to re-evaluate the stock's recent sell-off.
